description: Places near a point. lat and lng are required. neighborhood is optional.

lat.description: Decimal degrees. Send a number, not a string.

lng.description: Decimal degrees. Send a number, not a string.

neighborhood.description: Optional neighborhood name, such as Mission. lat and lng select the area.

radius_km.description: Radius in kilometers. Send a number, not a string.
